Ampliar considerablemente el conjunto de: Substantially expand the simulation set: generate more training information before concluding that the model architecture needs to change.
Aumentar la diversidad de los escenarios: Increase the diversity of the training scenarios: incorporate extreme events, infrequent combinations, and conditions outside the range currently considered.
Explicar claramente la clasificación bin: Explain the binary classification clearly: describe the criterion used to decide whether a node floods or not and how the classes are assigned.
Profundizar en la información que conduc: Examine in more depth the information that drives the classification: analyze which variables and hydraulic conditions lead the model to predict flooding or no flooding.
Aclarar la terminología de las variables: Clarify the terminology of the hydraulic variables: define precisely the difference between incoming discharge, inflow, and the variables related to flow magnitude or scaling.
Asegurar una comparación justa entre mod: Ensure a fair comparison between models: state explicitly that all were trained and evaluated with the same data, splits, metrics, and validation procedures.
Incorporar información temporal, espacia: Incorporate temporal, spatial, and topological information: include descriptors of the event evolution, of the prior hydraulic state, and of the relationships between neighboring, upstream, and downstream nodes.
Implementar una búsqueda sistemática de: Implement a systematic hyperparameter search: explain the automated procedure clearly and use Bayesian optimization, for example with Optuna.
Redefinir el objetivo principal de la in: Redefine the main research objective: specify whether the purpose is to develop a surrogate model to speed up hydraulic simulations, to support real-time decisions, or to combine both scopes.
Explicar con mayor claridad la arquitect: Explain the overall model architecture more clearly: identify the input variables, the predicted outputs, and the relationship between them.
Mejorar la interpretación de la importan: Improve the interpretation of variable importance: explain how importance is computed and how it should be interpreted from a hydraulic perspective.
Evaluar la suficiencia y representativid: Assess the sufficiency and representativeness of the dataset: justify whether the number and diversity of simulations are adequate to train the models and to evaluate their generalization capacity.
Justificar con mayor profundidad la sele: Justify the choice of algorithms in more depth: explain why linear models, support vector machines, and XGBoost were evaluated, including their advantages and limitations.
Analizar la influencia de los hiperparám: Analyze the influence of the main hyperparameters: evaluate how parameters such as maximum depth, number of trees, learning rate, and subsampling affect performance.
Extender la validación a nuevos escenari: Extend the validation to new scenarios: evaluate the model's ability to extrapolate beyond the training range and identify the conditions under which its predictions stop being reliable.
Profundizar en la discusión técnica de l: Deepen the technical discussion of the results: interpret performance from a hydraulic perspective, analyze the causes of the errors, and discuss limitations and practical implications.
Fortalecer la revisión de literatura: am: Strengthen the literature review: broaden and update the state of the art, specify the research gap, and explain how the work contributes to addressing it.
Reforzar el rigor metodológico y la repr: Reinforce methodological rigor and reproducibility: justify methodological decisions, document the procedures, and support them with scientific literature.
Explorar arquitecturas neuronales espaci: Explore spatiotemporal neural architectures: after expanding the data and improving the variables, evaluate an RNN and CNN combination to represent temporal evolution and relationships between nodes.
Evaluar una red hidráulica sin calibrar: Evaluate an uncalibrated hydraulic network as a complementary analysis: analyze how model performance changes and study the uncertainty associated with the simulations.
Definir variables de estado para eventos: Define state variables for multi-peak events: incorporate information such as the volume stored before each pulse to represent the residual storage of the network.
